post.description: "login" is treated as an email if it contains "@", otherwise as a username; both match case-insensitively. Returns an access token (expires after JWT_EXPIRES_IN, default 15m) and sets the refresh cookie. Rate limited.

401.description: Incorrect credentials or deactivated user (same response either way)

post.description: Reads the refresh cookie (no body or Authorization header needed), returns a new access token and rotates the cookie. Reusing an already spent refresh token ends the session, except within 10 seconds of it being spent (two tabs refreshing at once). Rate limited.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or reused refresh token, or deactivated user. The cookie is cleared; log in again.

post.description: Ends the session the refresh cookie belongs to and clears the cookie. No Authorization header needed. Succeeds even without a valid cookie. Discard the access token too.

info.title: Crumbtrail API
info.description: Backend for Crumbtrail, a recipe-sharing app. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (from POST /api/v1/users or /api/v1/auth/login) on every endpoint not marked as public. Access tokens are short-lived; browser clients renew them with POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, which reads the httpOnly `crumbtrail_refresh` cookie (send credentials on the auth calls). Errors use Nest's standard shape (ErrorResponse).

refreshCookie.name: crumbtrail_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Refresh token cookie set by login, registration and refresh. Browsers send it automatically.
